task: Make fresh release-unit reevaluation transaction-relative for operation kinds and allow only trusted canonical governance/evidence reprojection to refresh a persisted STALE child while material execution obligations remain unchanged.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live bounded rehearsal replay after the canonical proof fallback passed fresh semantic reevaluation but stopped on RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_OBLIGATION_DRIFT. The candidate worktree Atlas incorrectly reclassified base-to-candidate additions as modify operations, and the runtime treated trusted current governance/evidence reprojection exactly like material scope drift, making a persisted STALE child unable to recover after policy evolution.
observableOutcomes: Exact base-to-head diff status is the primary authority for create, modify, delete and rename operation kinds during actual transaction reevaluation.
Candidate Atlas existence cannot turn a canonical A diff into a modify operation.
A persisted STALE child may accept only governance/evidence metadata produced by the trusted fresh two-pass reevaluation when material obligations remain identical and current Release Risk is PASS.
Arbitrary fresh-manifest authority, gate, evidence or child-plan changes without trusted reprojection remain fail-closed.
Material scope, dependency, forbidden/read-only, generated-artifact, predecessor and risk drift remain fail-closed.
Accepted governance refresh recomputes canonical manifest, plan, operation and binding identity before materialization.
unresolvedRisks: Allowing generic drift would turn stale recovery into a scope-widening bypass.
Operation kind must remain stable across planned projection and actual candidate reevaluation.
A trusted flag must be established only inside the executor after the second strict Plan PASS.
Required evidence may legitimately change with current Known Failure applicability, but proof files must remain evidence-only and outside material operations.
Old persisted child identity must not be reused after an accepted canonical reprojection.

in: Add transaction-change-aware operation derivation with deterministic A/M/D/R mapping.
Pass canonical diff changes from Plan Before Code into release operation derivation.
Separate material execution-obligation drift from reprojectable governance/evidence drift.
Require explicit trustedFreshProjection authorization before accepting governance/evidence refresh on a STALE child.
Set trustedFreshProjection only after projection, child reprojection and second strict Plan PASS in the trusted executor path.
Add regression coverage for A→create stability, arbitrary evidence drift blocking, trusted governance refresh acceptance and material drift rejection.
out: No relaxation of exact-main lease, predecessor, forbidden/read-only, risk, CAS, PR, Truth or Lifecycle checks.
No automatic acceptance of material scope or operation drift.
No manual state reset, child PR, merge receipt or closure fabrication.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This controls the boundary between stale fail-closed recovery and write authorization. The repair must preserve exact material scope while allowing only current machine-proven governance metadata to replace stale derived metadata.

acceptanceCriteria: derivePlannedOperations accepts exact transaction changes and maps A=create, M=modify, D=delete, R=rename without consulting candidate existence for those paths.
Planned-projection behavior without exact transaction status retains Atlas-based create/modify fallback.
Fresh candidate Plan decomposition preserves create for a file absent on target base but present on candidate head.
obligation drift exposes material and reprojectable categories separately.
A STALE child accepts reprojectable governance/evidence drift only with trustedFreshProjection=true and zero material drift.
A PLANNED child or untrusted caller with the same metadata drift remains STALE.
Any operations, intendedFiles, dependency, forbidden/read-only, generated-artifact, predecessor or risk drift remains STALE even when trustedFreshProjection=true.
Trusted executor passes trustedFreshProjection only after the second strict Plan Before Code PASS.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle close before merge; unchanged rehearsal is replayed from persisted state.
invariants: Material release scope is never inferred from candidate file existence when exact transaction status exists.
Trusted freshness is an executor-produced fact, not a manifest-editable field.
Governance/evidence refresh cannot alter intendedFiles or operations.
Current strict Plan and Release Risk remain mandatory before authorization.
Existing exact PR, child CI identity, CAS state, Truth and Lifecycle authorities remain unchanged.

failureModes: Candidate Atlas reports a newly-added file as existing and operation kind flips.
Trusted proof/gate refresh is mistaken for material drift and stale recovery loops forever.
An untrusted caller marks governance drift as fresh and bypasses stale protection.
Material drift is hidden among governance changes.
Identity digests are not refreshed after accepted governance reprojection.
edgeCases: A file is added in candidate while absent on current main.
A file is modified in candidate and exists on current main.
A rename is present in exact diff.
Only requiredEvidence.proofFiles changes after Known Failure registry evolution.
Authority and gate chain change together while material scope is identical.
Both governance and operation drift occur in the same reevaluation.
STale U01 has no predecessor but later units require predecessor receipts.

alternatives.summary: Use base→head diff for operation identity and a trusted two-pass reevaluation marker to accept only derived governance/evidence refresh.
alternatives.reason: Preserves material fail-closed semantics while making canonical stale recovery possible.

alternatives.summary: Treat any current fresh manifest as authoritative and ignore obligation drift.
alternatives.reason: Would allow material scope widening through a stale recovery path.

alternatives.summary: Keep old authority/gates/evidence forever and only update base SHA.
alternatives.reason: Would execute against stale policy and negate current Knowledge/Plan authority.

alternatives.summary: Continue inferring operation kind only from candidate Atlas existence.
alternatives.reason: Cannot distinguish an addition from a pre-existing modification once the candidate has been materialized.

specialistReviews.finding: Operation identity belongs to the base-to-head transaction while semantic ownership belongs to the current candidate graph; they are different authorities.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use exact diff for operation kind and current Atlas/Plan for derived governance metadata.

specialistReviews.finding: Allowing stale governance drift without provenance would create an authorization bypass.
specialistReviews.resolution: Require an executor-only trustedFreshProjection fact established only after the two-pass strict reevaluation; arbitrary AUTHORIZE events remain blocked.

specialistReviews.finding: A stale child must adopt current proof/gates and new identity before materialization, but its material operation set must remain exactly stable.
specialistReviews.resolution: Classify drift into material versus reprojectable sets and refresh identity only after material equality is proven.

specialistReviews.finding: Current Known Failure regression proof is intentionally time-varying governance evidence and cannot remain frozen in a persisted child manifest.
specialistReviews.resolution: Permit canonical requiredEvidence refresh only through the trusted fresh projection path.

challenge.scenario: U01 fixtures are absent on target main but present in the materialized candidate worktree.
challenge.finding: Atlas existence alone returns modify and causes false operation drift.
challenge.resolution: Exact diff status A overrides Atlas existence and remains create.

challenge.scenario: Known Failure proof set grows while intended files and operations remain identical.
challenge.finding: Treating proof refresh as material drift traps STALE recovery.
challenge.resolution: Allow requiredEvidence refresh only under trustedFreshProjection after strict Plan PASS.

challenge.scenario: A caller directly invokes AUTHORIZE with changed proof or authority metadata.
challenge.finding: Without provenance it could spoof a canonical refresh.
challenge.resolution: Default trustedFreshProjection=false; existing drift block remains for untrusted callers.

challenge.scenario: Trusted reevaluation also changes an operation from create to modify.
challenge.finding: Governance acceptance must not hide material drift.
challenge.resolution: Material drift is evaluated first and blocks regardless of trustedFreshProjection.

challenge.scenario: Authority mapping changes under current Atlas while files stay the same.
challenge.finding: Executing stale ownership metadata would contradict current authority truth.
challenge.resolution: Trusted strict Plan may refresh derived authority after material equality and risk PASS.

challenge.scenario: Gate chain removes an obsolete gate or adds a new current gate.
challenge.finding: Freezing old gates can under- or over-state actual current proof obligations.
challenge.resolution: Trusted current gate chain replaces stale derived gate metadata before child CI identity is sealed.

challenge.scenario: A rename transaction is re-evaluated after candidate materialization.
challenge.finding: Candidate existence can obscure the previous path.
challenge.resolution: Canonical diff R status and previousFile remain the operation authority.

challenge.scenario: Accepted governance refresh changes manifest and child plan digests.
challenge.finding: Old binding must not survive into PR/CI.
challenge.resolution: Refresh release-unit identity after the accepted fresh projection and verify exact child context downstream.

Merge, verify fresh main CI, then replay the unchanged bounded rehearsal from persisted CAS state 91867d1a4693c6d4d630f5c9b37dbeb3cc00528c.

requirements.requirement: Fresh release-unit reevaluation must preserve transaction-relative material operation identity while allowing only trusted current governance and evidence projection to replace stale derived metadata after strict Plan verification.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Trusted freshness may never authorize changed material operations or scope.
Untrusted fresh-manifest metadata drift may never be accepted as canonical.
